about_the_game:
YourMusic is the official soundtrack for YourFocus — a productivity companion designed to help you stay focused, balanced, and inspired during long gaming or work sessions.

This collection features four original tracks, each produced in early 2025 and carefully crafted to reflect the themes of focus, motivation, and mental clarity that define YourFocus:

  • Catch The Shadow

  • Stormy Nights

  • Switched Reality

  • Wild Wide World

From deep ambient moods to uplifting electronic rhythms, every piece invites you to immerse yourself in the soundscape of productivity and creativity. Whether you’re working, studying, or gaming, YourMusic sets the perfect tone for your flow.
